props.text: Can it run Doom? Your Ignition gateway can. Pick a game; every one of them is a Perspective component with tags, alarms, saves and a deathmatch relay behind it.
The 1993 shareware episode: Knee-Deep in the Dead.
Raven's 1994 shareware episode: City of the Damned.
Beyond Heretic. Three classes, hub maps, mana. Bring your own hexen.wad: the demo carries no licence to ship it.
Quest for the Sigil. Rogue's 1996 talk-and-shoot. Bring your own strife1.wad (and voices.wad): no free data exists.
